text: このままでは　ロケットだん　アジトの　そんざいが　ばれちまう　ボスに　れんらく　しなくては！

structure.jp: ロケットだん　アジトの　そんざいが　ばれちまう
structure.en: the existence of the Rocket Hideout will get found out

structure.jp: ボスに　れんらく　しなくては！
structure.en: I have to contact the boss!

patterns.name: 〜なければならない
patterns.explanation: しなくては is a short way of saying しなくてはならない, 'must do', with the ending left off. れんらく　しなくては = 'I have to get in touch'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちまう is a rough, masculine short form of てしまう, which says the thing happens completely, to your regret. ばれちまう = 'it'll end up getting found out'.

patterns.name: 〜ままでは
patterns.explanation: このまま is 'as things are now', and では adds 'if it stays that way', leading to a bad result. このままでは = 'at this rate'.
